## PRODUCT DETAILS

### PRODUCT DETAILS

ROYAL CANIN® MINI EXIGENT is formulated for small breed adult dogs with fussy appetites that weigh up to 10 kg. - Pillow-shaped kibble with an exciting crunch texture filled with a pâté of flavoursome nutrients - Their crunchy exterior has a tasty, fatty coating, while the pâté filling is both rich and delicious All Royal Canin food is nutritionally complete and contains 100% of the high-quality proteins, fats, fibres, vitamins, and minerals that your dog needs for lifelong wellbeing. Our Exigent nutritional program has two components available: crunchy kibble and a delicious pâté in a pouch, both are nutritionally complete and perfectly complement each other. Don’t just take our word for it, ROYAL CANIN® MINI EXIGENT results are a proven success. Scientifically tested at the Royal Canin kennels, up to 99% of dogs preferred this food.

## BENEFITS

### BENEFITS

### SATISFIES A FUSSY APPETITE

Featuring ingredients and high quality proteins specially selected for small dogs, MINI EXIGENT has an aroma irresistible to the fussiest of eaters.

### ADAPTED KIBBLE

The size, shape, and density of MINI EXIGENT kibble has been specially designed for miniature jaws. With a pillow-shaped kibble that has a crunchy outside and a soft inside, every piece has an appetising texture your dog will love.
